definition_zh: 八月；威严的；令人敬畏的
definition_en: the eighth month of the year, and as an adjective, majestic and inspiring awe
core_image: 盛夏将尽时，一队披着长袍的祭司在石阶上缓缓走过
scene: 夏末的庭院里，石榴已经红透，热气还没有散。The family always visits the lake in August.
sceneCN: 这里 august 是「第八个月」（第 01 个义项）；句意是学校八月开学。

pos.zh: 形容词：威严的、令人敬畏的

derivatives.zh: 由 August 加 -an 构成，义为「奥古斯都时代的」
由形容词 august 加 -ly 构成，义为「威严地」

senses.title: The eighth month of the year
senses.definition: the eighth month of the year
senses.why: The month is named after Augustus Caesar, so August began as a proper name and then became the ordinary word for the eighth month.
senses.whyCN: 这个月以罗马皇帝奥古斯都命名，August 先作专名，后来才变成「八月」的普通说法。

senses.title: Grand and worthy of respect
senses.definitionCN: 庄严气派、令人肃然起敬的
senses.example: The old hall had an august presence.
senses.exampleCN: 这座古老的大厅有一种威严的气派。
senses.why: The adjective august comes from the same Latin word meaning consecrated or majestic, and it describes people or things that inspire reverence.
senses.whyCN: 形容词 august 来自同一个拉丁词，意为「神圣、庄严」，用来形容令人肃然起敬的人或物。

intro.en: The history of august is traced through the stages below; thin evidence is marked as such.
intro.cn: august 的历史按下面几个阶段追溯；证据不足处如实标注。

items.cn: 称号 augustus 意为「神圣的、受尊崇的」。

items.en: Augustus derives from augere, 'to increase', with a religious charge of growth.
items.cn: Augustus 来自 augere「增加」，带增长与祝福的宗教意味。

items.en: The month Sextilis was renamed Augustus in honour of the emperor.
items.cn: 罗马历中原名 Sextilis 的月份为纪念皇帝改称 Augustus。

items.en: English took the month name through the church calendar as August.
items.cn: 英语经由教会历法吸收这个月名，作 August。

items.en: The adjective august 'majestic' entered separately from the same Latin title.
items.cn: 表示「威严」的形容词从同一拉丁称号另路进入英语。

note.en: The look-alike group collects words close in form, root or spelling; the near-meaning group collects words from the same everyday field.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写、词根或构词相近的词；近义组收同一日常语义场里的词。

entries.definition: A word that stands close to august in form or root.
entries.definitionCN: 月份背后的罗马称号与人名，与本词同源。

entries.definition: A word that stands close to august in form or root.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「增加」，与 august 同出 augere。

entries.definition: A word that stands close to august in meaning.
A word that stands close to august in meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 宏伟庄重，接近本词的形容词义。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the word's real partners: its fixed phrase, its family, its recorded origin and its closest field.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子都建立在真实材料上：固定搭配、词族、可查的词源与最近的语义场。

normal.en: The fixed phrase 'in August' gives the word one clear home.
normal.cn: 固定搭配「in August」给了这个词一个清楚的落点。

normal.en: The family word 'Augustan' shows how the meaning extends.
normal.cn: 词族里的「Augustan」展示了词义如何向外延伸。

normal.en: Its recorded origin passes through LATIN AUGUSTUS and LATIN AUGERE.
normal.cn: 可查的来源经过 LATIN AUGUSTUS 与 LATIN AUGERE 两个阶段。

normal.en: In the same field sits 'July'; compare the two when you recall the word.
normal.cn: 同一语义场里还有「July」，回想时把两者放在一起比较。

normal.en: The form 'Augusts' is what you will meet in running text.
normal.cn: 在连续文本里，你常遇到的形式是「Augusts」。

abstract.en: Picture robed priests walking slowly down stone steps at the end of high summer, then let the picture change size until it covers both the everyday object and the figurative use.
abstract.cn: 想象盛夏将尽时，一队披着长袍的祭司在石阶上缓缓走过，再让画面变大变小，直到它同时罩住日常实物与比喻用法。

abstract.en: Place the word inside the scene given in this entry; what stays in memory is the picture, not the translation.
abstract.cn: 把 august 放进本词条给出的场景里；留在记忆里的是画面，不是翻译。

abstract.en: Link the word to one object you can point at, then to the idea that object lends to the other senses.
abstract.cn: 把 august 与一件能指认的具体事物挂钩，再挂到该事物借给其他义项的那层意思。

examples.en: The old hall had an august presence.
examples.cn: 这座古老的大厅有一种威严的气派。

examples.en: We visited the museum in August.
examples.cn: 我们八月参观了博物馆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥古斯特」——联想到盛夏将尽时，一队披着长袍的祭司在石阶上缓缓走过

root: 拉丁语 augustus「受尊崇的」，来自 augere「增加」；月名与形容词都出自这一称号。

sensesIntro.en: August is two words in one spelling: the eighth month, and an adjective meaning majestic. The month is pronounced with a short final syllable, the adjective with a long one.
sensesIntro.cn: august 是同一个拼写下的两个词：八月，以及意为「威严」的形容词；月份读音尾音短，形容词读音尾音长。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: robed priests walking slowly down stone steps at the end of high summer
core.cn: 核心意象：盛夏将尽时，一队披着长袍的祭司在石阶上缓缓走过

branches.en: MONTH: the eighth month of the calendar.
branches.cn: 月份线：日历上的第八个月。

branches.en: SUMMER: the last full month of the school holiday.
branches.cn: 暑假线：假期里最后一个整月。

branches.en: NAME: Augustus Caesar, the source of the name.
branches.cn: 命名线：名字来自奥古斯都皇帝。

branches.en: BEARING: a person with an august manner.
BUILDING: an august hall or temple.
branches.cn: 建筑线：庄严的厅堂或神庙。
